fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior treatment with an EGFR TKI is not allowed, however if a candidate for this study has already started osimertinib within 21 days prior to randomization, the exact osimertinib start date is known, and the patient had the required study baseline imaging completed prior to the osimertinib start date, the patient will be eligible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex exception regarding prior osimertinib start within a 21-day window cannot be expressed with a standard typed rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiation (limited field stereotactic radiation or conventional radiation) must have been completed at least one week prior to study drug initiation and more extensive field radiation (i.e., whole-brain radiotherapy [WBRT]) must have been completed at least two weeks prior to drug initiation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout windows depending on the type and field of radiation are too complex for a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not have any risk factors for anti-VEGF administration, specifically, hemoptysis, active cardiovascular disease, uncontrolled hypertension, significant proteinuria (screening urinalysis > 300 mg/dl) and tumor invading major blood vessels
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Combines multiple risk factors and qualitative criteria like tumor invasion into a single exclusion rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have measurable disease. Baseline measurements of sites of disease must be obtained within 4 weeks prior to study randomization.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not have had any prior systemic treatment for metastatic disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of prior systemic treatment specifically for metastatic disease interacts with the complex prior osimertinib start rules.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not have any evidence of severe or uncontrolled systemic diseases, including uncontrolled hypertension and active bleeding diatheses, which in the investigator's opinion makes it challenging for the patient to participate in the study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Relies entirely on investigator opinion and clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (serum glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase [SGOT])/alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (serum glutamate pyruvate transaminase [SGPT]) =< 2.5 x institutional ULN (obtained =< 14 days prior to randomization)
